subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], we are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123, Departure: 15th August 2022 at 10:00 AM, Arrival: 16th August 2022 at 2:00 PM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. Have a pleasant journey!
